name: Govara
summary: An AI governance verification platform. Companies run their AI, privacy and security compliance in one workspace, and a credentialed human auditor verifies it against frameworks like ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act. I’ve worked on it since the early stages, and most recently added a Payload CMS admin panel and wire transfer payments alongside the existing Stripe checkout.
